traits.note: The Flora of North America's account of Stenocereus, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): stigma lobes 5 to 15, white; the carpels are as many as the stigma lobes (Hamburg's Botany Online on the family, as quoted in search results; the page itself was not read).

traits.stem_form.note: Britton and Rose's The Cactaceae (vol. 2, 1920, p. 85), as Lemaireocereus, which held today's Stenocereus: usually large, tall, branching columns, ribbed, the areoles large and felted on the ribs.
